snippet.title: Crazy Chicken Traps and Treasures 3. Game for PS4 & PS5. Official English video.
snippet.description:
Platforming fun in the land of the Pharoahs!
Egypt - an ancient and mysterious country on the banks of the Nile. Deep inside a pyramid lies the magnificent sarcophagus of TUT EGG KHAMUN, just waiting to be discovered! Join Crazy Chicken as he embarks on his treasure-hunting adventure, following the 30 clay tablets to the burial chamber, dodging deadly traps, fighting cunning enemies and finding hidden treasure along the way!

• Run and jump your way through 31 levels
• Collect coins, artifacts and golden statues
• Defeat enemies and master every challenge
• See how you measure up with online leaderboards
• Replay levels to improve your score

Find out how you did at the end of every level with a detailed report of your performance - collectables, enemies, points - everything!
